hero.heading: We buy pallets. We'll never build them.
hero.body: AGL is a brokerage with no plant of its own and no intention of ever having one. When we bring you volume, we're not building a book to move in-house in three years. We don't have anywhere to move it to.

offer.heading: What working with AGL looks like

items.body: We're placing programs for manufacturers who order every week, not chasing one-off loads.

items.lead: Paid when we said we'd pay.
items.body: Terms are terms. If that's the thing that's burned you before, ask us about it directly.
We will never own manufacturing and we will never compete with you for your own accounts.
We ask what your equipment runs well before we send you a spec, not after you've quoted it.
You build. We book the truck and deal with the delivery window.

ask.heading: What we need from you
paragraphs: Consistent build quality against the spec, honest lead times — including when they slip — and a phone call when something changes. That's most of it. We qualify shops on whether the pallets are right and whether we hear the truth early, not on being the cheapest quote in the file.
